name: chevron-up
description: A balanced upward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The fill-only contour is the exact union of the Regular 1.70 stroke exterior, with radius-.85 free-end caps. Straight edges, internal intersections and any rounded outer joint are constructed analytically from the Outline centerline. Line marks have no enclosed body or counter to fill; both styles intentionally retain the same recognizable mark at Regular. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. Owner requested visibly rounded arrow bends across all arrow-bearing icons. The old sharp V is replaced by a tangent circular centerline arc of radius1.50 centered at12 10.25, with straight tangent arms. Preserve the prior free endpoints, shaft, native visible bounds, centering and Regular1.70 weight. The visible outer bend radius is2.35 and inner bend radius .65; free caps remain .85. Filled is the exact analytical1.70 stroke band around this rounded head, unioned with its separate shaft where present. Transfer trays stay unchanged. This is actual centerline rounding, not only a round stroke join. Both styles remain drafts awaiting owner review.
